text: Ko waɗi kon ɓe leptaa, ko tawde Nulaaɓe maɓɓe ɓen addanayno ɓe hujjaaji ɓannguɗi, immorde ka Allah, ɓe yedda Allah, ɓe fenna Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen. E ko ɓe doolnunoo kon fow, Allah naangiri ɓe lepte, O halki fii maɓɓe, tawde pellet, ko O Doolnuɗo, Saɗtuɗo leptugol yedduɗo Mo, fenni Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen.
